name: bell
description: Rings the terminal bell (BEL) when the assistant's turn completes, so your terminal tab shows an attention indicator and plays a sound.

config.description: Master switch; false keeps the plugin loaded but silent.
Grace window after a final message; a new provider request within it cancels the bell (turn is continuing).
Output device path; empty means the controlling terminal (/dev/tty). Test/diagnostic override only.
